استعلمت (form X)
# اِسْتَعْلَمْتُ (istaʕlamtu) /is.taʕ.lam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
# اِسْتَعْلَمْتَ (istaʕlamta) /is.taʕ.lam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
# اِسْتَعْلَمْتِ (istaʕlamti) /is.taʕ.lam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
# اِسْتَعْلَمَتْ (istaʕlamat) /is.t
